name: VERSATL
recent: 近期只有大股东（Lim 家族及 NSK Trading）连续多日的持股变动申报，以及一笔 5,000 股凭单转换新股上市，没有其他业务或财报公告。
notable: 大股东 Lim 家族成员及 NSK Trading 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
Warrants A 转换 5,000 股新股，已于 2026 年 10 月 26 日上市。
risks: 大股东在多个交易日连续申报持股变动，具体增减方向未在标题中说明。

events.what_en: Listing of new shares from warrant conversion

recent_en: Recent filings consist only of consecutive substantial shareholder changes by the Lim family and NSK Trading, plus the listing of 5,000 new shares from warrant conversion; no other business or earnings announcements.
notable_en: Substantial shareholders from the Lim family and NSK Trading filed multiple changes in their shareholdings between October and November 2026.
5,000 new shares from conversion of Warrants A were listed on 26 October 2026.
risks_en: Substantial shareholders filed consecutive shareholding changes over multiple trading days; the direction of change is not stated in the titles.
